reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in her DM. I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492 is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025: the gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next shift went through fine.
2. #4419 is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it too: the barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support. The note has no date, so I told Dana I can't say when it was logged or whether it's still open.

None of Moss's other notes mention a QFL ticket. I told Dana I'd left out three tickets in the Central digests (#4409, #4412 and FR-882), which belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways", a different company that isn't a customer. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so Dana can put them in the weekly notes without anyone's approval.
